description: Rescales a phase ramp by a ratio of two whole numbers, and adds swing to the result.

params.text: Sets the first number of the ratio, 1 to 99; raising it slows the output down.
Sets the second number of the ratio, 1 to 99; raising it speeds the output up.
Moves the beat away from the middle of the output cycle, 1 to 99, stretching the first part of the output ramp and squeezing the rest.

inputs.text: 0-10V here sweeps the first number of the ratio between 1 and the number set by its knob, rounded to a whole number.
0-10V here sweeps the second number of the ratio between 1 and the number set by its knob, rounded to a whole number.
Bends the swing away from its knob setting, reaching 1 at -5V and 99 at +5V.
The phase ramp to rescale, 0-10V per cycle.
A trigger here sends the output phase to 0 and fires a pulse from the CLK output.

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger at the swung beat of each output cycle, or a square held high through the first half of it when Gate Mode is on.
The rescaled phase ramp, 0V to 10V per cycle, with the swing already applied.

notes: Nothing happens until a phase ramp is patched to the PHASE input; this module never takes a phase from the module beside it.
What it does with its neighbours is pass the ZZC clock connection along and add its own phase to it, for a Div (Expander) further down the row to pick up.
menu: Gate Mode — replaces the 1ms trigger at the CLK output with a square held high through the first half of each output cycle
Tick on Start — fires an extra pulse at the moment the output cycle restarts, as well as at the swung beat

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob setting alone; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads the knob setting alone; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.2:
±5V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads the SWING knob alone.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads no phase, and no output movement.
inputs.4:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads no reset; a negative voltage does nothing here.
